parent_objective: design bidirectional active-set objective that protects correct-history and wrong-history branches separately
blocked_by: M1356 pivots because normal-branch retention alone makes wrong-history branches successful

public_gates: M1357 must not use private holdout
M1357 must preserve actor input contract
M1357 must design correct-history and wrong-history active-set constraints separately
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run a new actor update

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: opens a new branch after M1356 synthesis to design separate correct-history and wrong-history replay constraints
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, full replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design only anchors normal trajectories
stop if design ignores M1355 wrong-history safe rows
stop if design permits PPO before no-PPO proof probe
fallback_plan: if wrong-history branch constraints can be expressed with existing replay rows, route to implementation
if wrong-history trajectory anchors are missing, route to rejected-branch trajectory export
if margin-gap residual is insufficient, route to branch-asymmetric preference design
if public proof surfaces are stale, route to source-diverse surface refresh
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1356 opens the bidirectional active-set retention branch

admission_evidence: M1355 preserves normal branch but fails by making wrong-history rows 6,10,13,15,16 successful
M1356 synthesizes the prior branch and pivots to branch-asymmetric retention
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1357 designs intervention-proof machinery and cannot claim anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve outcome difference between normal and wrong-history branches before any stronger claim
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1355 wrong-history success-drop washout rows and M1336 materialized source-history histories.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If branch-asymmetric constraints cannot be expressed, record that fixed replay surfaces are insufficient and route to surface refresh.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A bidirectional active-set design can avoid the M1355 failure by protecting both correct-history success and wrong-history rejected/failure behavior.
success_criteria: design identifies M1355 wrong-history safe rows as active constraints
design specifies no-PPO implementation admission criteria
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, replay run, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design routes directly to PPO or promotion
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, replay run, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1357 passes as a design milestone only if it specifies branch-asymmetric replay constraints while keeping training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, replay execution, and actor-input changes blocked.
